name: Satin bonnet, scarf or pillowcase at night
what_people_do: Cover the hair with a satin or silk bonnet or scarf, or sleep on a satin pillowcase.
why_they_say_it_works: Cotton "steals moisture" and rubs hair, causing breakage; a cover keeps a style and edges neat.

documented_by.source: Dawson S, 'Why do Black people wear bonnets', Madame Noire, 6 Nov 2025 (opened 12 Nov 2026)
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Madame Noire, 6 Nov 2025: bonnets and scarves keep pressed or curled styles, reduce friction breakage and keep moisture; framed as cultural pride.

evidence.finding: My search (PubMed "satin bonnet scarf hair") found nothing; no trial read.

source.name: agent4-traditional-practices.md, 12 Nov 2026 (research file in this project)
